rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matching to a single account. It checked the provided order (which didn’t contain a camera), then located the correct delivered order with the digital camera. Before making any changes, the agent explicitly asked for confirmation to proceed with a return and refund to the original payment method. After receiving confirmation, it executed the return via the tool, which updated the status to “return requested” and specified the refund to the original Mastercard ending in 8484. All actions were confined to the authenticated user’s account, no unsupported claims were made, and final information matched tool outputs.
